_about: T6: the style grade for one fight. Every landed hit scores its damage times a percentage built from these bonuses; the grade is the points per point of damage dealt, in percent, so fights of any size grade alike. Worked examples are in crates/core/src/style.rs's tests.

meter._about: The live meter in the HUD: hits, combos and air time fill it with the points they score; it holds grace_ticks after the last gain, then drains a point every drain_every ticks; a bite takes bite_times its damage. Ranks are its floors, highest first.
